issues.detail: The case offers two obstructions: a symlink to outside the repository or a regular file. This fixture builds only the regular-file variant. That is a reasonable choice because file graders can observe it. The symlink variant stays untested.
issues.fix: If the symlink variant matters, build a separate fixture with runtime.outsideDirs and judge-graded writes through the link.

issues.detail: Assertion 1 is complete:true on state alone: WorkflowState SYNCHRONIZING, Handoff.Kind unchanged, Recovery inactive, and the record absent. A run that leaves state untouched but tells the user synchronization passed or sign-off is ready would still PASS. A correct run is never failed, and the catalog marks the assertion deterministic-complete, so this is acceptable. Optionally set complete:false so the judge also sees the reply.
issues.fix: Optional: set complete:false on assertion 1 so the judge can catch a reply that claims readiness without a state change.

issues.detail: A plain-text ops-notes file named 'synchronization' with no extension under .standards/docs is a slightly odd place for a user to keep notes. The case requires this obstruction, though. The content and commit message are neutral and do not hint at the answer.

summary: The fixture builds the regular-file variant faithfully. Every stated condition is realized: all upstream records are COMPLETE and consistent, check.mjs passes, and artifact init refuses at the obstructed path. The checks and invariants do not penalize a correct run, which may set BlockedOn in STATE.md, and nothing leaks; the notes above are minor.
